'''Ran Deezy''' was a [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who studied the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Ran Deezy was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual of an [[Ran Deezy's species/Legends|unknown species]], was inducted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at a young age and began [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Stationed at the Temple throughout the war, Deezy, joined by fellow student [[Farn Klin]], attended a gathering of Jedi in a [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|Temple comm station]] when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] sent a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] transmission in which the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] gloated over his capture and [[Torture/Legends|torture]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]]. Due to the shocking nature of the hologram, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] asked [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to escort Deezy and Klin out of the transmission room.<ref name="GI" />

==Behind the scenes==
The young Jedi learner of an unidentified species and gender was briefly featured in "[[Grievous Intrigue]]," the ninth episode of of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]].<ref name="GI" /> The character made a small cameo in the episode "[[Lightsaber Lost]]."<ref name="Lightsaber Lost">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref>
